correctness.rationale: TARGET route (research_report.claim_route=TARGET): audited against admitted target_claim. Orders verified: |L3(8)|=16482816=512*511*63 (PSL(3,8), d=gcd(3,7)=1), |:3|=49448448, |:6|=98896896; Out=6 matches ATLAS. Frobenius tables (frobenius_all.log, frobenius_L38d3.log, GAP 4.12.1/CTblLib 1.3.7): L3(8) only (2a,3a,7g/7h) n=1 CMC49 and (2a,3a,7i/7j/7k) n=15/7 CMC105, rest 0; :3 (2a,3a,7c/7d) n=1/3 CMC49, (2a,3a,7e) n=15/7 CMC105, all outer 3b/3c 0; :6 (2a,3a,7b) n=1/3 CMC49, (2a,3a,7c) n=15/14 CMC105, all 2b/3b/3c 0; CMC cross-check consistent (centralizer 49 class CMC49; larger centralizer CMC105). L3(8) non-generation: 73-pt p73bB0 rep-check (a order2, b order3, ab order21, |G| exact), |2a|=4599 matches |G|/3584, exhaustive scan of class 2a per 7-class rep (5 small-centralizer reps): 49-pair classes -> |H|=168 throughout, 49/49 IsConjugate to ATLAS L2(7) M5; 105-pair classes -> |H|=504 throughout (PSL(2,8) order), 105/105 in max1/max2 parabolic conjugate (56/105 each, overlap 7, union 105/105 via 73-transversal membership) per nongeneration_L38.log + attribution_L38.log tails. Since all other (2,3,7) triples empty per table, no generating triple exists. L3(8):3 obstruction is proof, not sampling: ATLAS max1W1 builds N order16482816, IsNormal true, index3, quotient C3, eN=1 fN order3; any homomorphism to C3 kills orders 2,7 (coprime to 3) so all involutions/7-elements lie in N (census 3/0 and 1039/0 confirmatory), hence x,z in N implies y=x^-1z^-1 in N, <x,y><=N<G; sampled triples {168,504} consistent. Aut obstruction likewise proof: max1W1 builds M1=:3 order49448448 normal index2 quotient C2; odd orders 3,7 forced into M1 (census 267/0, 1061/0 confirmatory); positive triples use 2a (C21504 inside) since all 2b entries 0, so every positive triple lies in non-Hurwitz M1. Corrupt p73aB0 copy excluded, p73bB0 used. Dependence on GAP/ATLAS libraries versioned and hashed. Computational certificates are replayable; quotient steps are theorems. No essential inference, boundary condition, or computation fails.

originality.rationale: Fused live retrieval (SerpBase Top10 + OpenAlex Top15 + Crossref Top15 per query, 3 consolidated queries, no partial failure, 20 fused results) plus direct ATLAS L3(8) page fetch. Nearest priors: Conder update (simple PSL(3,q) condition; q=8=1 mod7 non-Hurwitz simple control only), Lucchini large-rank (no PSL3(q) except PSL3(2) Hurwitz, simple only), Malle G2(q) (character-plus-maximal template, different family), Salih 2021 socle-PSL(3,q) genus-zero braid components (adjacent layer), ATLAS L3(8) page (inputs only). No source publishes per-class (2,3,7) constants for L3(8):3/Aut, outer-class vanishing, or extension non-Hurwitz verdicts. Simple-group theorems do not imply extension decisions (extension could use outer elements; need per-class outer-zero + trapping proof). Adversarial checklist (synonyms, encodings, dominance, database, implication) documented in decisive_checks; all fail to cover the :3/:6 window. Simple-group leg is admitted replay control; novelty rests on extensions and holds.

value.rationale: Hurwitz (2,3,7)-generation is a recognized benchmark (Hurwitz/Macbeath, Liebeck-Shalev) controlling Riemann-surface automorphisms, Beauville structures, expander Cayley data. Scope W={L3(8),L3(8):3,Aut} is the canonical almost-simple layer over fixed socle PSL(3,8) where the simple-group criterion stops deciding -- minimal natural extension window, not arbitrary slice or parameter substitution. Result supplies independently retrievable exact data: complete normalized (2,3,7) constant tables for :3 and Aut (including outer-class vanishing 0, values 1/3, 15/7, 15/14, CMC 49/105), exact subgroup orders 168 (L2(7)) and 504 (PSL(2,8)) with named-maximal attribution (L2(7) M5; parabolics max1/max2 2^6:(7xL2(8))), and machine-checked quotient/reduction chain killing both extensions. Motivated before computation, not known or mechanically implied, future researcher could need the precise obstruction/table. Negative verdict does not erase value; headline is a self-contained exact obstruction certificate. Not a textbook restatement, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.

claim_vs_prior_implication.evidence: Compared hypotheses/conclusions literally. Conder/Lucchini/Cohen: hypothesis = simple PSL(3,q), conclusion = non-Hurwitz for q=8. Submitted claim: hypotheses = L3(8):3 and Aut(L3(8))=L3(8):6 (different groups with outer classes 3b/3c, 2b and distinct 7-class fusions), conclusions = complete normalized tables (1/3, 15/7, 15/14, outer zeros) plus non-Hurwitz via socle/index-3 and :3/index-2 trapping. Malle: different group family. Salih: genus-zero braid orbits, not (2,3,7) Frobenius/generation attribution. ATLAS: inputs without verdict.
claim_vs_prior_implication.search: Screened snippets/metadata of fused Top-20 plus full ATLAS L3(8) page fetch; title/embedding similarity not used as coverage.
claim_vs_prior_implication.why_not_covering: A prior need not state the headline verbatim to defeat it, but none here substantively implies it: simple-group non-generation does not imply extension non-generation (outer-element generation possible in general); the submitted proofs require the additional facts that outer (2,3,7) constants vanish and that all positive triples are trapped in the verified normal socle/:3 subgroup -- facts absent from priors.
